description: Defines the TlsConnection class and its Delegate for managing TLS connections using BoringSSL in a QUIC context, including callback mechanisms and encryption secret management.

classes.name: TlsConnection
classes.description: Manages a TLS connection using BoringSSL, handling callbacks, secrets, and encryption levels.

classes.name: TlsConnection::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback implementations related to certificate verification, secret setting, message writing, and alerts.

methods.name: VerifyCert
methods.description: Verifies the peer certificate chain, returning verification result.

methods.name: SetWriteSecret
methods.description: Sets the encryption secret for outgoing messages at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: SetReadSecret
methods.description: Sets the decryption secret for incoming messages at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a TLS message to be transmitted at a specified encryption level.

methods.name: FlushFlight
methods.description: Signals that current messages are ready to be flushed to the transport.

methods.name: SendAlert
methods.description: Closes the connection with a TLS alert error code.

methods.name: DisableTicketSupport
methods.description: Disables session ticket support in SSL.

methods.name: QuicEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Converts BoringSSL's ssl_encryption_level_t to QUIC's EncryptionLevel.

methods.name: BoringEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Converts QUIC's EncryptionLevel to BoringSSL's ssl_encryption_level_t.
